iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: IAEA pressure remains high. Reuters/Al-Monitor report a U.S. draft IAEA resolution demanding Iran provide precise information on damaged sites and enriched uranium stocks. Tehran warns it will respond to watchdog action; safeguards visibility remains impaired.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR / GULF
iran_conventional.notes: Gulf war risk remains near maximum. Reuters reports Hormuz remains closed or severely disrupted, drones toward the Strait, and oil flows forced into constrained alternate routes while U.S.-Iran contacts stay uncertain.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon risk eases slightly after a conditional ceasefire announcement, but Al Jazeera and Reuters-linked reporting still show fighting after the truce announcement. De-escalation channel exists but has not fully controlled events.

turkey.name: TURKEY REGIONAL
turkey.notes: Turkey remains indirectly exposed to Iran-war spillover, Syria/Iraq routes, and emergency measures. Search found no fresh Turkish direct clash, weapons trial, or major regional operation crossing activation threshold.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan watch rises marginally after Al Jazeera reported at least 11 killed in Pakistan-administered Kashmir clashes before a rally. This is serious internal unrest but not a verified cross-border India-Pakistan exchange.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO spillover remains acute. UN coverage and Reuters report Romania/NATO airspace fallout after a Russian drone incident, with the UK summoning Russia's ambassador and eastern-flank readiness stressed.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan remains elevated on baseline posture and prior encirclement exercises, but today's search did not surface a fresh June blockade, live-fire surge, or direct clash crossing signal threshold.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: DPRK remains critical on baseline capability. Reuters reported Pyongyang reaffirming its nuclear status on June 6 and May missile activity, but the scan found no fresh launch or atomic-device event inside this update window.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine remains at maximum. Reuters reports a Zaporizhzhia nuclear-plant safety scare involving Rosatom engineers during an IAEA-brokered local pause, while ISW reports continuing large drone strikes.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan remains critical from unresolved border-war posture, but fresh search results were mostly March background rather than new June escalation. Probability edges lower pending fresh evidence.

sudan.name: SUDAN CIVIL WAR
sudan.notes: Sudan remains critical on baseline civil-war spillover and humanitarian risk. Fresh 24h search was dominated by older/background material rather than a newly verified escalation trigger.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza risk rises. Reuters and Al Jazeera report Israeli strikes killing civilians while Egypt hosts renewed talks; later-phase implementation remains stuck over police, withdrawal, disarmament, and governance issues.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN / ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan/Abyei remains elevated. UN/France statements warn Sudan spillover and South Sudan instability are degrading Abyei conditions, but no fresh 24h kinetic trigger crossed activation threshold.
